line: The firm everything since has been built out of.

roleLong: CMO & Co-Founder, later strategic advisory board
line: Co-founded it. Ran growth through two exits.
achievement: Co-founded LOVOO and led marketing through nine years of scaling, then sat on the strategic advisory board until 2022. Two exits: the acquisition by The Meet Group for $70M in 2017, and The Meet Group's sale into the ProSiebenSat.1 group for roughly $500M in 2020.
Co-founded the intermittent fasting app that passed 50 million downloads and became the global category leader, funded by a €4.3M seed round for US expansion.

line: Performance marketing for Web3, and WalletAds.

line: Grow your app, or exit. Founders decide.

line: Sensor fusion and AI for NATO and European partners.
